mapper.select: WITH , latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (u.wizard_id) u.wizard_id, u.wizard_name, u.country_code AS country, u.channel_uid, CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT) AS score, CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(u.rating_id::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) ELSE NULL END AS rating_id, r.date_add AS last_match_at FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON u.replay_id = r.rid WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(u.ladder_score::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT) > 0 ORDER BY u.wizard_id, r.date_add DESC ), ranked AS ( SELECT latest.wizard_id, latest.wizard_name, latest.country, latest.channel_uid, latest.score, latest.rating_id, latest.last_match_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY latest.score DESC, latest.wizard_id ASC) AS rank_position FROM latest ) SELECT r.rank_position, r.wizard_id, r.wizard_name, r.country, r.channel_uid, r.score, r.rating_id FROM ranked r WHERE LENGTH(TRIM(#{query})) >= 1 AND ( TRIM(BOTH FROM r.wizard_id::text) = TRIM(#{query}) OR ( r.wizard_name IS NOT NULL AND POSITION(LOWER(TRIM(#{query})) IN LOWER(r.wizard_name)) > 0 ) ) ORDER BY r.rank_position ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT season_code AS "seasonCode", season_no AS "seasonNo", league_type AS "leagueType", season_name AS "seasonName", start_at AS "startAt", end_at AS "endAt", is_active AS "isActive", sort_order AS "sortOrder" FROM rta_season ORDER BY sort_order ASC, season_no DESC, season_code ASC
SELECT start_at, end_at, season_code FROM rta_season WHERE season_code = #{seasonCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE( ( SELECT season_code FROM rta_season WHERE start_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND end_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY sort_order ASC, season_no DESC LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT season_code FROM rta_season ORDER BY season_no DESC, season_code DESC LIMIT 1 ) )

SELECT rating_id AS "ratingId", grade_name AS "gradeName", grade_abbr AS "gradeAbbr", tier_key AS "tierKey", min_win_points AS "minWinPoints", rank_rule AS "rankRule", icon_url AS "iconUrl", tier_sort AS "tierSort" FROM public.rta_rating_grade WHERE tier_key IS NOT NULL ORDER BY tier_sort NULLS LAST, rating_id

WITH sid AS ( SELECT season_id FROM public.rta_season WHERE season_code = #{seasonCode} LIMIT 1 ), mx AS ( SELECT MAX(s.snapshot_at) AS ts FROM public.rta_snapshot_rank_cut s WHERE s.season_id = (SELECT season_id FROM sid) ) SELECT s.snapshot_at AS "snapshotAt", s.rating_id AS "ratingId", rg.tier_key AS "tierKey", rg.grade_name AS "gradeName", rg.grade_abbr AS "gradeAbbr", s.cutoff_score AS "cutoffScore" FROM public.rta_snapshot_rank_cut s INNER JOIN public.rta_rating_grade rg ON rg.rating_id = s.rating_id CROSS JOIN mx WHERE s.season_id = (SELECT season_id FROM sid) AND mx.ts IS NOT NULL AND s.snapshot_at = mx.ts ORDER BY rg.tier_sort NULLS LAST, s.rating_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.rta_rank_cutoff_anchor_snap (snapshot_at, sort_order, anchor_key, tier_key, cutoff_score) SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, sub.sort_order, sub.anchor_key, sub.tier_key, sub.cutoff_score FROM ( WITH , anchors AS ( SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, '3h', INTERVAL '3 hours'), (2, '6h', INTERVAL '6 hours'), (3, '12h', INTERVAL '12 hours'), (4, '3d', INTERVAL '3 days'), (5, '7d', INTERVAL '7 days') ) AS v(sort_order, anchor_key, iv) ), base AS ( SELECT r.date_add, CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT) AS score_val, ( CASE WHEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 5000 THEN 'L' WHEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 4000 THEN 'G' WHEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 3500 THEN 'P' WHEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 3000 THEN 'C' WHEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 2000 THEN 'F' ELSE 'Ch' END ) || CASE WHEN (CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) % 10) IN (1, 2, 3) THEN (CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) % 10)::text ELSE '2' END AS tier_key FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON u.replay_id = r.rid WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(u.rating_id::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 1000 AND TRIM(COALESCE(u.ladder_score::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT) > 0 AND r.date_add::date >= ( SELECT (MAX(r2.date_add::date) - INTERVAL '120 days')::date FROM rta_match_in_season r2 ) ), tiers AS ( SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('G3'), ('G2'), ('G1'), ('P3'), ('P2'), ('P1') ) AS tv(tier_key) ) SELECT a.sort_order, a.anchor_key, t.tier_key, COALESCE( (SELECT MIN(b.score_val) FROM base b WHERE b.tier_key = t.tier_key AND b.date_add >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - a.iv AND b.date_add <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 0 )::bigint AS cutoff_score FROM anchors a CROSS JOIN tiers t ) sub

INSERT INTO public.rta_snapshot_rank_cut (season_id, snapshot_at, rating_id, cutoff_score) SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.season_id, rg.rating_id) s.season_id, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, rg.rating_id, COALESCE(( SELECT MIN(CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT)) FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN public.rta_match m ON m.replay_id = u.replay_id WHERE m.played_at >= s.start_at AND m.played_at < s.end_at AND TRIM(COALESCE(u.rating_id::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) = rg.rating_id AND TRIM(COALESCE(u.ladder_score::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT) > 0 ), 0)::bigint FROM public.rta_season s INNER JOIN public.rta_rating_grade rg ON rg.tier_key IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.season_id, rg.rating_id
mapper.select: SELECT c.opponent_combo_key AS "opponentComboKey", c.opponent_combo_size AS "opponentComboSize", c.win_cnt AS "winCnt", c.lose_cnt AS "loseCnt", CASE WHEN (c.win_cnt + c.lose_cnt) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * c.win_cnt::numeric / (c.win_cnt + c.lose_cnt)::numeric, 2) ELSE NULL END AS "winRate", ( SELECT string_agg(m.kr_name, ' + ' ORDER BY z.ord) FROM unnest(string_to_array(c.opponent_combo_key, ',')) WITH ORDINALITY AS z(id, ord) LEFT JOIN public.monster m ON m.monster_id = NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM z.id), '') ) AS "opponentLabel" FROM public.rta_agg_counter_matchup c WHERE c.season_id = (SELECT season_id FROM public.rta_season WHERE season_code = #{seasonCode} LIMIT 1) AND c.subject_unit_id = #{monsterId} AND c.rating_id = 0 ORDER BY (c.win_cnt + c.lose_cnt) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 40
